title: Sum of Beauty of all substring
problemStatement: Solve “Sum of Beauty of all substring” as posed in the A2Z sheet (Medium String Problems).
intuition: "Sum of Beauty of all substring" needs careful pointer rewiring. Draw before/after. Prefer O(1) aux when possible; never lose the next reference before rewiring.

approaches.title: Hash / multi-pass when helpful
approaches.idea: Store nodes or lengths when it simplifies correctness, then optimize.

approaches.title: Optimal pointer technique
approaches.idea: Fast/slow, dummy head, or in-place reverse — adapt to the problem.

commonMistakes: Forgetting dummy head for head-deletion cases
patternRecognition: Intersection → length align or switch pointers
interviewInsight: For "Sum of Beauty of all substring", interviewers watch pointer hygiene more than clever tricks.
